person_names.name: 李文博
person_names.cue: common word: '文' (culture/literature) suggests academic or literary background; contrastive: '博' (broad/knowledgeable) implies erudition, unlike typical names with 'wei' (weave) or 'jun' (army).

person_names.name: 张晓峰
person_names.cue: common word: '晓' (dawn) implies early morning or enlightenment; spelling cue: 'feng' (wind) contrasts with similar-sounding 'feng' (feng shui), but 'feng' here suggests a peak or summit.

person_names.name: 王思远
person_names.cue: common word: '思' (thought) indicates introspection; contrastive: '远' (distant) contrasts with 'jin' (near), emphasizing philosophical distance over physical proximity.

person_names.name: 陈子轩
person_names.cue: common word: '子' (son) is traditional and scholarly; spelling cue: 'xuan' (dazzling) sounds like 'xuan' in 'xuanwu' (mystical creature), but here it suggests brilliance.

person_names.name: 刘佳宁
person_names.cue: common word: '佳' (excellent) is frequently used; contrastive: '宁' (peaceful) is uncommon in female names, which often use 'xin' (heart) or 'yan' (grace).

person_names.name: 赵明宇
person_names.cue: common word: '明' (bright) is widespread; spelling cue: 'yu' (universe) sounds like 'yu' in 'yuyuan' (jade garden), but here it suggests vastness or cosmic scale.

person_names.name: 孙若曦
person_names.cue: common word: '若' (as if) is poetic; spelling cue: 'xi' (dawn) in 'xi' (dawn) vs. 'xi' (to rejoice) – here, 'xi' evokes morning light.

person_names.name: 周晨曦
person_names.cue: common word: '晨' (morning) is descriptive; contrastive: '曦' (sunlight) is rare in names; often confused with 'xi' (to kiss), but 'xi' here means radiant light.

place_names.name: 黄山
place_names.cue: common word: 'Huang' (yellow) is a color; contrastive: 'shan' (mountain) suggests elevation, but 'Huangshan' is famous for its unique granite peaks, not yellow rock.

place_names.name: 丽江
place_names.cue: common word: 'Jiang' (river) is a water feature; spelling cue: 'li' (pearl) is poetic, but 'Lijiang' is a river, not a pearl; often mistaken for 'Lipu' (pearl town).

place_names.name: 敦煌
place_names.cue: common word: 'Dun' (to press) is ambiguous; contrastive: 'Huang' (yellow) is absent, but 'Dunhuang' is known for its caves, not desert yellow.

place_names.name: 喀什
place_names.cue: common word: 'Kash' (in 'Kashmir') is phonetic; spelling cue: 'Shi' (city) is misleading – 'Kashi' is a Uyghur city, not 'Kash' as in 'Kashmir'.

place_names.name: 峨眉山
place_names.cue: common word: 'E' (to rise) is rare; contrastive: 'Mei' (beautiful) suggests beauty, but 'E'mei' means 'brow of the mountain', not 'beautiful mountain'.

place_names.name: 腾冲
place_names.cue: common word: 'Teng' (to rise) is ambiguous; spelling cue: 'Chong' (to rush) implies movement, but 'Tengchong' is a town in Yunnan, not a rushing place.

place_names.name: 九寨沟
place_names.cue: common word: 'Jiu' (nine) is numerical; contrastive: 'Zhai' (fortress) is misleading – 'Jiuzhaigou' is a valley, not a fortress, despite 'zhai'.

place_names.name: 额尔古纳
place_names.cue: common word: 'E' (to rise) is common; spelling cue: 'Er' (two) is phonetic, but 'E' is not 'E' as in 'E' for 'E' in English; the name is a river in Inner Mongolia.

organization_names.name: 中国航天科技集团
organization_names.cue: common word: 'China' (zhongguo) is clear; contrastive: 'Kongtian' (spaceflight) vs. 'Kongjun' (air force) – this is civilian space tech, not military.

organization_names.name: 阿里巴巴集团
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Alibaba' is phonetic; spelling cue: 'Group' (jiti) is common, but 'Alibaba' is not 'Ali' (a name), and the company is not 'Alibaba' in Arabic.

organization_names.name: 南方电网
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Nanfang' (south) is directional; contrastive: 'Dianwang' (electric grid) vs. 'Dianxin' (telecom) – this is power, not communication.

organization_names.name: 国家电网
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Guojia' (national) is clear; spelling cue: 'Dianwang' (power network) is literal, but 'Guodian' (national power) is not 'Guo' as in 'country' only.

organization_names.name: 中国铁路总公司
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Zhongguo' (China) is clear; contrastive: 'Tie' (iron) vs. 'Tie' (tie) – 'Tie' here is 'rail', not 'tie' as in 'tie a knot'.

organization_names.name: 华为技术有限公司
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Hua' (flower) is common; contrastive: 'Wei' (to protect) is misleading – 'Hua' here is a brand name, not 'flower'.

organization_names.name: 腾讯控股有限公司
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Tencent' is phonetic; spelling cue: 'Konggu' (hold) is literal, but 'Tencent' is not 'Tong' (common) or 'Zhi' (wisdom).

organization_names.name: 中石油
organization_names.cue: common word: 'Zhong' (middle) is neutral; contrastive: 'You' (oil) vs. 'You' (to have) – 'Zhongyou' is 'Sinopec', not 'middle oil'.

brands.name: 小米
brands.cue: common word: 'Xiao' (small) is descriptive; contrastive: 'Mi' (rice) is literal, but 'Xiaomi' is not 'small rice' – it’s a brand name derived from 'xiao' and 'mi'.

brands.name: 华为
brands.cue: common word: 'Hua' (flower) is misleading; spelling cue: 'Wei' (to protect) is not literal – 'Huawei' is a phonetic name, not 'flower' and 'protect'.

brands.name: 格力
brands.cue: common word: 'Ge' (to grasp) is rare; contrastive: 'Li' (to measure) is ambiguous – 'Geli' is not 'grasp' and 'measure', but a brand name.

brands.name: 耐克
brands.cue: common word: 'Nai' (to endure) is misleading; spelling cue: 'Ke' (to overcome) is not literal – 'Nike' is a transliteration, not 'endure' and 'overcome'.

brands.name: 苹果
brands.cue: common word: 'Pingguo' (apple) is literal; contrastive: 'Ping' (flat) vs. 'Ping' (to ping) – 'Pingguo' is a fruit, not 'flat fruit'.

brands.name: 优衣库
brands.cue: common word: 'You' (excellent) is clear; contrastive: 'Yiku' (clothing store) vs. 'Yiku' (to write) – 'Youyiku' is not 'excellent writing'.

brands.name: 星巴克
brands.cue: common word: 'Xing' (star) is literal; contrastive: 'Bing' (to freeze) is misleading – 'Xingxing' is not 'star' and 'freeze'.

brands.name: 迪奥
brands.cue: common word: 'Di' (to place) is ambiguous; spelling cue: 'Ao' (to climb) is not literal – 'Dior' is a transliteration, not 'place' and 'climb'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 李娜
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Li' (to hold) is common; contrastive: 'Na' (to knead) vs. 'Na' (to be) – 'Li Na' is a tennis player, not a baker.

ambiguous_entities.name: 张伟
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Zhang' (to stretch) is widespread; spelling cue: 'Wei' (to protect) vs. 'Wei' (to be) – 'Zhang Wei' is a common name, not 'stretch and protect'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 北京
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Bei' (north) is directional; contrastive: 'Jing' (capital) vs. 'Jing' (to be calm) – 'Beijing' is the capital, not 'north calm'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 上海
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Shang' (up) is ambiguous; spelling cue: 'Hai' (sea) vs. 'Hai' (to be) – 'Shanghai' is a city, not 'up sea'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 中国
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Zhong' (middle) is neutral; contrastive: 'Guo' (country) vs. 'Guo' (to go) – 'Zhongguo' is China, not 'middle go'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 支付宝
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Zhi' (to control) is common; contrastive: 'Fu' (to be) vs. 'Fu' (to be wealthy) – 'Zhifubao' is a payment app, not 'control be'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 微信
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Wei' (to protect) is ambiguous; spelling cue: 'Xin' (heart) vs. 'Xin' (to believe) – 'Weixin' is a messaging app, not 'protect heart'.

ambiguous_entities.name: 抖音
ambiguous_entities.cue: common word: 'Dou' (to dance) is common; contrastive: 'Yin' (to draw) vs. 'Yin' (to be dark) – 'Douyin' is a video app, not 'dance draw'.
